integrity: The finite identity follows from an exact marked-cycle bijection, not simulation. The sign law uses the exact mean total-cycle formula, and the threshold uses a harmonic-tail Riemann sum plus a gamma-ratio asymptotic. Independent exact enumeration of weighted permutations replays the finite formulas through order seven.
scientific_limitations: The exact Palm identity is specific to the Ewens family with fixed positive parameter.
The threshold describes covariance with total cycle or allele count and does not imply a full conditional stochastic ordering.
An equivalent marked-cycle identity may occur implicitly in older Ewens generating-function or size-biased partition literature.
title: Ewens frequency counts switch covariance sign at a macroscopic threshold
